name: WGEasy
post_parameters: -c "for b in iptables ip6tables; do for s in '' -restore -save; do ln -sf /usr/sbin/$b-nft$s /etc/alternatives/$b$s; done; done; exec docker-entrypoint.sh /usr/bin/dumb-init node server/index.mjs"
description: WireGuard VPN with a web UI (wg-easy v15): create clients, QR codes and configs in the browser. First visit opens a setup wizard: create the admin user, then choose 'No' (new setup), set Host to your public IP or DynDNS name and Port to the VPN host port below (52820). Forward UDP 52820 in your router. The web UI runs over plain HTTP (INSECURE=true) - keep port 8084 LAN-only. Uses the nftables iptables backend (kernels without legacy iptable_nat, e.g. MOS).

paths.name: Config
paths.description: Database, keys and WireGuard config (back up!)

paths.name: Kernel modules
paths.description: Do not change: lets the container load the WireGuard module

ports.name: WireGuard
ports.description: VPN port (UDP). Must be the same number as 'Port' in the setup wizard; forward it in your router.

variables.name: INSECURE
variables.description: Allow the web UI over plain HTTP (LAN only; use a reverse proxy for HTTPS)

variables.name: DISABLE_IPV6
variables.description: Disable IPv6 inside the VPN (the default Docker bridge has no IPv6)
